This document outlines the equipment inspection I1, to be performed 
every 2000 equivalent operating hours EOH as indicated in the title block the 
hot gas casing collect the hot gases push it under pressure to move the blades 
of turbine with velocity 4582 rpm.

A work permit must be issued, the maintenance staff should carry the 
 suitable safety category
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required
Wear safety and healthy equipment as safety helmets, shoes, gloves .. etc
Turbine must be shut down
Fuel system ( solar gas ) of gas turbine out of service
Isolate the step- up transformer and it's circuit breaker

Isolate the circuit breaker of all pump motors and disconnect the electrical 
terminal of all pump motors
Fire fighting system must be out of service

Hot 
gas casing must be in weather temperature
Complete maintenance tool set
Ladder
Detector fluids for cracks
Cleaning fluids ( W D 40 )
Rags
Crane 25 ton
Dismantle the burner of unit
Take the burner out side the unit using Crane 25 ton
Put a ladder inside combustion chamber
Use the ladder to arrive the hot gas casing
Inspect the hot gas casing using detector fluids of cracks
If we have some cracks in the body of hot gas casing
We weld these cracks using the electrodes UTP 6170 CO.

After we finish from welding take the ladder out side the combustion 
 chamber and clean it
Install the burner in its position.

Introduction
This document outlines the equipment inspection I1, to be performed 
every 2000 equivalent operating hours EOH as indicated in the title block the 
hot gas casing collect the hot gases push it under pressure to move the blades 
of turbine with velocity 4582 rpm.
Technical data:
Manufacturer | : | ABB Switzerland
Type of fluid | : | Compressed hot gases
Temperature | : | 900 C
The first draft initiated by eng. Mostafa 
Ibrahem Hamza, revised by eng. 
Samir Abdel Gilel: EDEPC inspection and quality control general director & MPIS 
coordinator, approved by eng. Hamdy 
El-Melegy:
 El Shabab GT
general director.
This document is accepted by eng. Samir Abd El Gilil EDEPC MPIS 
coordinator, and certified by accountant Mahmoud Mohamed Soliman; EDEPC 
Planning & financial prediction head sector and supervisor of 
inspection and quality control head sector.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued, the maintenance staff should carry the 
 suitable safety category
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required
Wear safety and healthy equipment as safety helmets, shoes, gloves .. etc
Turbine must be shut down
Fuel system ( solar gas ) of gas turbine out of service
Isolate the step- up transformer and it's circuit breaker
Isolate the circuit breaker of all pump motors and disconnect the electrical 
terminal of all pump motors
Fire fighting system must be out of service
Hot 
gas casing must be in weather temperature
Tools and Equipment
Complete maintenance tool set
Ladder
Detector fluids for cracks
Cleaning fluids ( W D 40 )
Rags
Crane 25 ton
Work to be Carried Out
Dismantle the burner of unit
Take the burner out side the unit using Crane 25 ton
Put a ladder inside combustion chamber
Use the ladder to arrive the hot gas casing
Inspect the hot gas casing using detector fluids of cracks
If we have some cracks in the body of hot gas casing
We weld these cracks using the electrodes UTP 6170 CO.
After we finish from welding take the ladder out side the combustion 
 chamber and clean it
Install the burner in its position.
